query.description: Whether to include credentials for `oauth2AuthorizationCode` in the response. If true, `accessToken` and `scopes` are included. To include `refreshToken` as well, set `includeRefreshToken` to true. Default is false.

Whether to include `refreshToken` for `oauth2AuthorizationCode` credentials in the response (along with `accessToken` and `scopes`). If true, the `includeCreds` query parameter will be ignored. Default is false.

Whether to refresh the access token. If value is `ifExpired`, the access token will be refreshed only if it has expired. If value is `force`, the access token will be refreshed regardless of its expiration.
